items.title: Keep sessions to one task each
items.detail: Each reply read 191k tokens on average in the last 7 days (145k the week before). Re-reading it was 42% of Claude spend. Start a new session, or /clear, for each new task.

items.title: Start fresh after a break instead of resuming
items.detail: 18 cache rebuilds cost $20 in the last 7 days (18 the week before). The cache expires after an idle hour, so after a break start a new session, or /compact before you step away.
